description: On a pursuit to save his father's printing press in the heart of Purani Delhi, a man becomes a disciple of a revered poet and falls in love with his daughter. Torn between his love and honoring his mentor, he must make a choice that could change his life forever.

title: Tere Ishk Mein
description: A psychology student attempts to rehabilitate a volatile young man, before evolving into a doomed romance.

title: Parvati
description: A short film exploring mental health problems and trauma of a rape victim.

title: Flames
description: Mahesh, a ‘low’ caste migrant farmworker, is forced to go on a run to protect his son who gets accused of a murder.

title: Chhota Bheem: Dinosaur World
description: When a scientist has trouble caring for his secret baby dinosaur, he takes Bheem and friends back in time to return the pet to its natural habitat.

title: Bas!
description: Her rebellion isn’t noise, it’s the birth of her own right!

title: Dhurandhar
description: In the early 2000s, an undercover operative infiltrates Karachi's underworld, breaking into its inner circle to dismantle a violent nexus from within.

title: Mamta Child Factory
description: Two small-town real estate agents help a city doctor establish a surrogacy hospital, battling local prejudices and traditional mindsets in their conservative community.

title: Early Days
description: The film follows the beginnings of a relationship between Preeti and Samrat, an aspirational couple in their mid-twenties who have just moved to the megalopolis of Mumbai. As they share their love story via reels on social media, where the immediate validation and promises of quick money initially seduces, and then propels them into the world of influencers.

title: Good Better Best
description: A disillusioned writer, grappling with creative and personal failures, embarks on a darkly introspective journey to explore the meaning of life and death.

title: Rehna Nahi Bin Tere
description: The film "Rehna Nahi Bin Tere" intimately explores his life, his experiences with love, and his evolution into the responsible man his industrialist father always envisioned, as he rises to lead the family business.

title: Janki
description: Raghu loves Janaki deeply but is unable to express his feelings. Meanwhile, Janaki`s marriage is arranged with Raghu`s brother. Will Raghu go against his brother to win her love?

title: Apna Amitabh
description: This is a story of a young boy named Vijay. He lives with his family in a small village named Dakita Meerganj. Vijay studies in the 9th standard of a government school. He is a huge fan of Super Star Amitabh Bachchan and always tries to behave like him. He was born in a lower cast family. And Vijay's father Anna Jamadar's profession is to clean toilet of the village. All the villagers tease Vijay by calling him after his father's profession as "Anna Safaiwale ka Beta" (cleaner's son), which he doesn't like. This film is cast cast-based political drama.

title: The Great Shamsuddin Family
description: Set over one day in Delhi, Bani, a writer, is racing against a career-defining 12-hour deadline. Mothers, aunts, cousins and former romantic interests descend on her apartment, each bringing their own emergencies and Bani has to navigate interfaith complexities, generational conflicts and family expectations as she faces a dilemma, which could alter her life trajectory forever.

title: Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2
description: Mohan wants to marry the love of his life, Sania, but destiny has a madcap plan! He ends up marrying three women of different religions and chaos follows.

title: Sitaaron Ke Sitaare
description: Sitaaron ke Sitaare follows the extraordinary journeys of parents raising children on the spectrum. The film traces the parents' lives from the earliest days, marriage, pregnancy, childbirth, the first signs that something was different, years of struggle, living in a system that failed them, to an unimaginable instance of seeing their children being auditioned for a film and being embraced by the mainstream.

title: Durlabh Prasad Ki Dusri Shadi
description: Story revolves around a son who, in an unexpected turn of events, decides to arrange a marriage for his father in order to fulfill the demands of his potential better half's family, who insist on having a woman in the household.

title: Rise
description: At a state basketball trial, Safi's fate rests in the hands of the formidable coach Yudhisthir. Their identical pasts but contrasting choices ignite a fierce battle - will Safi become Yudhisthir or Rise as himself?

title: Scenes from a Situationship
description: A contemporary couple drift through a situationship where intimacy comes easily but commitment is endlessly postponed, revealing how modern love survives on closeness while quietly eroding under unspoken expectations.

title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
description: When a carefree NRI wedding planner and a headstrong novelist collide during a wild summer in Croatia, sparks fly in ways neither expected. What begins as playful clashes soon transforms into something deeper – only to be tested when love, family, and tradition pull them in opposite directions.

title: K.G.N
description: In British-ruled India, two brothers, one a law-abiding police officer, the other a fiery revolutionary - are torn apart by betrayal and injustice, but must unite to avenge their father's death and free their village from colonial tyranny.

title: Manque
description: A person who is dealing with hallucinations due to extreme drug consumption tries a new drug that made his condition even worse.

title: I Bleed Ashes
description: Shaan and Raghu are deeply in love. Shaan struggles to conceal his true self but finds the courage to come out of the closet with Raghu’s unwavering support. In turn, Raghu faces his own battle with a cigarette addiction. For Shaan, quitting is a significant sacrifice, as he relinquishes a habit he once relied on. Together, they demonstrate that love involves letting go of fear and finding comfort in each other.

title: Ikkis
description: Second Lieutenant and India's youngest Param Vir Chakra recipient, Arun Khetarpal, gave his life fighting for his battalion and the country during the 1971 Battle of Basantar. Ikkis also takes a reflective look at the futility of war through the eyes of Khetarpal's father, who visits his ancestral home in Sargodha and Alma Mater for reunion, which now happens to be in post-partition Pakistan, 30 years later.

title: Varun Grover: Nothing Makes Sense
description: Varun Grover in his first-ever stand-up special, can't make sense about African Cheetahs landing in India, growing up as a Punjabi, nostalgia for the 90s, increasing intolerance, intergenerational trauma, IRCTC website and it's obsession with captcha and threats to free speech in the biggest democracy in the world.

title: Azad Bharath
description: Freedom fighter Neera Arya joins India's first women's army founded by Subhas Chandra Bose, highlighting untold stories from India's independence movement and themes of courage and patriotism.

title: UKV's Dandelions
description: Ten Friends Navigate Their Complex Lives Grappling With Mental Health Issues , Trauma And Personal Struggles As They Try To Find Hope And Resilience In The Face Of Adversity

title: Madness of Medley
description: A small karaoke studio becomes a quiet refuge for a group of strangers turned friends. Over the course of four years, music weaves together lives, creating deep bonds among regulars. Through music, they’ve found connection, routine, and a sense of belonging in a city that can often feel distant, overwhelming and alienating. What began as casual visits slowly turned into a small community built on singing and shared experiences. The film follows “Jyoti More and Groups” as they come together to prepare for a grand celebration marking a journey of their community.

title: Kal Kisne Dekha Hai
description: A 19 year old boy who is tired of usual stuffs plans a solo trip to Goa

title: Elaichi: Ek Prem Katha
description: In Elaichi, the spice of desire, Sonal’s quiet domestic life explodes into nights of burning lust when a chance encounter with a younger actor turns into a frivolous sexual affair - pushing her deeper into obsession until her family, her body, and her soul are scorched by betrayal.

title: The Memory Jar
description: Two people sacrifice truth for each other, only to discover the other did the same.

title: Hunter Among Us
description: A group video call unhinges when one friend threatens suicide online. Next - hijacking their feed, a masked hacker turns the group’s desperate attempts to save their friend into a sadistic mind game.

title: Aasmani
description: In Hindi (an Indian language) Aasmani means that shade of light blue which is the colour of the sky. To Smita, a spunky woman in her sixties, her steadfast companion of over five decades, a powder blue vintage FIAT called Aasmani is the very sky that shaped her life. They had journeyed through all the hues of life. Seasons, landscapes and relationships changed but Smita and Aasmani stayed together.  In the winter of their lives, Smita and Aasmani's precious bond turns increasingly precarious. They find themselves struggling with dwindling funds to maintain functionality and questions of relevance. There is growing pressure to replace Aasmani with a more modern cost effective alternative. Desperate to hold on to Aasmani, Smita partners with her precocious, razor sharp 10 year old granddaughter Tiya to find a way to save her.  Will they be able to save Aasmani? Or will Aasmani do her own saving? Buckle up and get ready for a bumpy but never not fun ride.

title: Audition Room
description: A man on his journey to becoming an actor faces struggles with creative understanding, family expectations, and societal pressure.

title: Muntazir
description: Set entirely within a single scene, Muntazir unfolds in real time as a quiet confrontation shaped by waiting, power, and unspoken desperation.  Through restrained performances and careful observation, the film explores how tension accumulates in moments where very little seems to happen, yet everything is at stake.

title: Charchaughi
description: Society shuns a single mother, who raises three of her daughters out of wedlock. As the daughters grow up, they find their own ways to fight the social and personal challenges they face.

title: Stars at Noon
description: A family in the circus.

title: Ragebait
description: A careless student tries to submit a last minute assignment using A.I. but many hurdles awaits him

title: Maya
description: Maya, a physiotherapist in her forties, relocates to the UK after a painful divorce and the loss of her ability to conceive. Living with her caring aunt Ammu, she withdraws emotionally and immerses herself in work. Her routine changes when she begins treating Mahesh, a stubborn sixty-year-old Marathi man recovering from a fracture. Initially hostile, Mahesh agrees to therapy after intervention from his son Siddharth, an optimistic widower and devoted father. As sessions progress, Mahesh's vulnerability emerges, and Maya saves his life twice. A quiet bond forms through shared loneliness, while Maya also feels drawn to Siddharth's warmth.

title: Murders Too Close, Love Too Far
description: Two police officers are brutally murdered in a rural police station. A senior CBI officer, Ram Chaudhary, investigates and crosses paths with a talented artist, Gita, as the mystery deepens and their relationship evolves, intertwining personal and procedural threads leading to the story's revelation.

title: Smart Killer
description: About a Smart Killer

title: One Two Cha Cha Chaa
description: So, Fuel Up, Gear Up, Level Up and Fasten your seat belts for the wildest and wackiest road trip of all time.

title: Safia/Safdar
description: When Salman falls ill, his saloon is at stake as the local moneylender wants it. The only person standing in the way is Salman's daughter, Safia. Will she be able to keep the salon running as Safdar?

title: Rahu Ketu
description: In the magical world of writer Churu Lal Sharma, his unlucky creations Rahu and Ketu spring to life, causing hilarious chaos instead of fighting corruption. When the mischievous Meenu Taxi steals Churu's mystical notebook, the bumbling duo are dragged into absurd adventures that land them in the middle of a drug mafia.

title: Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos
description: Chronically unsuccessful MI7 operative Happy Patel is finally assigned a mission in Goa, where he uncovers his Indian roots and must rescue a high-profile scientist from crime lord Mama. Unaware of his Indian heritage and armed with a comically British accent, Happy’s blunders trigger a string of chaotic mishaps that could lead him to expose a criminal network.

title: The Argument: Was it ever over?
description: WHAT REMAINED WASN'T SILENCE.

description: In the gritty underbelly of the modern world, a 20-something bounty hunter clings to 90s nostalgia, rocking vintage bell bottom pants and attire .When his sharp-tongued Bounty Agent drops a high-stakes contract—to hunt down and eliminate a slippery target named Simon—he dives headfirst into a pulse-pounding adventure. Armed with retro grit , he navigates action , high-octane chases, and brutal showdowns, all for the ultima  IMDB ID (tt0137523) - Optionalte payout.

description: At a city fun fair, three strangers an aspiring actor losing faith, a woman torn between love and honour, and a boy chasing shattered dreams find their lives reflected in a Ferris wheel where pain and hope rise and fall.

description: Returning to sell his late father's home, a successful man uncovers the small, unseen ways his father showed love, forcing him to confront the emotional distance between fathers and sons.

description: A student film showcasing 4 fictional characters discussing the Pahalgam attack (2025)

description: This comedy-drama children’s film follows the summer adventures of an oddball trio as they chase their dreams and unite to build a swimming pool in a water-strapped slum.

description: Arjun, a UK based cab driver who is financially struggling to get his estranged wife and daughter back, finds an opportunity to make GBP 25,000 The job is simple: Deliver a parcel to a given address. Along the way, helps a hitchhiker Liza by giving her a ride. But what he doesn’t know is how he is endangering both their lives.

title: Mardaani 3
description: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down those behind the disappearance of young girls, risking everything to bring them back alive.

description: In a Mumbai theater, a producer, his son, and two intruders clash during one night over hidden treasure. As they search for gold, deception grows, secrets emerge, and past wounds resurface.

description: One room, a reporter, and a convicted criminal. What begins as an interview turns into a tense face-off that exposes a chilling truth.

description: Harsh Gujral's first comedy special uploaded online

description: The plot centers on a deep, selfless connection between a man and a woman from different worlds, focusing on true feelings over material wealth, despite social pressures and the man's poverty. Originally shot in 1986, it had its direct-to-TV premiere in 2026.

description: The murder of an innocent civilian by the Gange's war fighters ignites the fury of Tiger, an army man who embarks on a relentless path of revenge. As he delivers justice, the law ultimately stands with him, blurring the line between vengeance and righteousness.

description: Two friends wake up in their office to find the city overrun by zombies after a mysterious outbreak. As they struggle to survive, hidden tensions, broken relationships, and selfish choices turn their escape into a deadly game. Will they make it out alive?

description: A manhole cleaner and vegetable vendor fall in love during secret meetings in a train bathroom. When she stops appearing, he begins a dangerous search to find her.

description: Two rival neighbors and their wives embark on a chaotic road trip, encountering two eccentric brothers who transform their journey into a hilarious adventure full of mishaps and unexpected twists.

description: During a single intense night, a father and son become trapped in an unexpected situation that forces them to confront guilt, responsibility, and a life-changing decision that tests their relationship.
