description: Love is contagious wherever you are.

title: Last 1%
description: Last 1% follows Aariz, a young student living away from home, whose life suddenly turns tense after receiving an urgent message about his mother. With only 1% battery left on his phone, he rushes through the city trying to reach home while facing unexpected situations and people along the way. As time keeps slipping away, Aariz must make difficult choices that test his emotions, patience, and humanity.  The film is a gripping emotional journey about time, decisions, and the moments that can change a life forever.

title: O'Romeo
description: What fate awaits a stonehearted gangster and bloodthirsty womaniser when true love claims him, helpless and unguarded? A gang war that shakes the entire underworld and crime syndicate to their very roots. A forbidden love; the tale of an unrequited passion.

title: Haye Hukku Haye Hukku Haaye Haaye Haaye
description: Daksh and Insha Are Close Friends Who Have Never Seen Each Other Romantically, But Their Families Misinterpret Their Bond And Arrange Their Engagement  Desperate To Escape , They Make A Dramatic Announcement - Daksh Declares That He Is Gay, While Insha A Lesbian - And The Engagement Is Immediately Called Off Leaving Their Families In Shock , What Begins As A Silly Plan To Avoid Marriage Slowly Backfires When Daksh And Insha, Spending More Time Together Amidst The Chaos , Begin To Develop Real Feelings Now Trapped By Their Own Lie , They Must Find The Courage To Confess Both The Truth And Their Love Turning The Raita They Created Into A Happily-Ever-After

title: Distant
description: Inder, suspended from work, wanders through uncertain days with his curious young son, concealing his own failures while attempting to shield the child from their consequences. Elsewhere, an ageing priest and his son clash over tradition, memory, and the meaning of faith, as buried histories resurface. Parallel to them, Kunti returns home after years in prison, confronting a father whose dreams for her were undone by rebellion and circumstance.

title: Don’t Scroll
description: This too shall pass.

title: Shatak
description: The narrative covers a century of institutional history, revealing how a small group expanded its mission and membership to achieve widespread influence.

title: Assi
description: When Parima, a school teacher in Delhi, is gang-raped on her way home late at night after an office party, Raavi, a prosecution lawyer, fights tooth and nail to help her get justice. But when eighty sexual assault cases are reported in India every single day, regardless of age group, ethnicity, time, or place,  and only four go to trial, what does justice really mean?

title: Do Deewane Seher Mein
description: Two socially awkward millennials in Mumbai find love while struggling with self-acceptance. As they battle insecurities and societal pressure, their journey takes them from city chaos to mountain serenity.

title: Heartstrings
description: Tanmay and Kalki spend their final hours together, as their seven-year relationship comes to an end. Heartstrings is about the small moments, the things left unsaid and the love that now has no place to go.

title: The Prisoner
description: Daksh deals with his mental battles relying on only the two people he talks to, however, a new admirer enters into his life, bringing chaos. Daksh deals with the three of them but the final, mind-bending realization changes him completely.

title: The Kerala Story 2
description: Three young Indian women across different states choose love over tradition, only to become trapped. Their parallel lives show how romance and rebellion transform into control and silence, turning love into a weapon that destroys freedom.

title: Nukkad Naatak
description: After being caught robbing the college canteen, best friends Molshri and Shivang are expelled. To be reinstated, they must enroll five children from an impoverished slum into a local school.

title: Accused
description: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels. Now under a storm of suspicion and scrutiny, her marriage fractures and the truth blurs. Her wife must decide whether to walk away, or fight for the woman the world is turning against.

title: Chaar Diwaari
description: A tenant moves into a too good to be true Mumbai apartment only to realise that the house is shrinking in size.

title: KAAM 25
description: A story where 3 ambitious small time gangsters set up a deal with a drug lord but they get kidnapped into an interrogation.

title: Rang De!
description: In the middle of all noise, one colour feels different.

title: The Gratitude List
description: This film explores love, communication, and the feelings we often leave unspoken in relationships. As two individuals confront their emotions and unexpressed thoughts, their journey reveals how understanding and honesty can reshape a relationship.

title: Jim Jam Jelly
description: Get Ready For The Ultimate Adventure "Jee Le Zaraa" Join The Journey Of Friendship , Self-Discovery And Thrilling Experiences With Laughter , Excitement And Unforgettable Moments , This Series Will Take You On A Ride Of A Lifetime

title: Kaustubh Agarwal: Banger Issues
description: Stand up special by Kaustubh Agarwal

title: Chai aur Parchi
description: Sometimes, it's not the tea that burns; it's the words left behind. A simple note, a simple moment, and a silence that grows heavier with every passing second. Chai aur Parchi is an 11-minute suspense drama about the things we ignore until they refuse to be ignored.

title: Subedaar
description: Haunted by loss and drifting away from his daughter, a retired Subedaar Arjun Maurya’s newly found civilian life is jolted by one reckless act. As old wounds reopen, he must summon the warrior within to face a new kind of war - one that hits too close to his heart.

title: Chalti Ka Naam Gaadi
description: Life follows the script written by destiny.

title: Black pepper
description: Kala kagaz is a short film that feature the story of two that have big dreams

title: Unseen Moves: A story of trust
description: When Harsh falls for Tanya in an intense online romance, their love unravels into a dangerous game where nothing is as it seems.

title: Na Jaane Kaun Aa Gaya
description: A love triangle. From Kaushal's breaking world to Tina's silent emotional conflict and Veer's transparent and blunt love, three hearts navigate guilt, longing, and impossible choices.

title: Charak: Fair of Faith
description: The disappearance of two children creates tension in a village, as locals suspect the involvement of a nearby ascetic tribe.

title: Life Without Mother
description: This story is about the struggle of two children after their mother's death.

title: Ramyaa
description: A compelling crime drama that explores human emotions, relationships, and the struggles of individuals trying to find their place in society, unfolding through an intense and engaging narrative.

title: Kissa Court Kachahari Ka
description: Ditching traditional melodrama for raw grit, the story offers an authentic dive into the Indian judicial system. Set within the corridors of a district court, it highlights the human cost of bureaucracy and the grueling struggle for justice through a stark, realistic lens.

title: Beyond the Pages
description: While reading Aarav's diary, Vanya finds herself drawn back to a quiet afternoon in college and a classmate who carried more silence than words. Through a diary and a conversation about fathers and absence, she begins to understand that love often hides behind fear, and that some calls remain unanswered long after they are made.

title: The Unfated
description: 'Aapkarmi' (The Unfated) is a brief confrontation with the fasting practice of 'Teej' and how it is experienced differently by a little girl, a young woman and their mother.

title: Pretend Play
description: Pretend Play follows a young content creator documenting his mother’s fractured memory, transforming personal pain into educational and emotional online content in pursuit of visibility and digital relevance.

title: KATTI (Un-friend) : The Heartfelt Story of Father & Son
description: KATTI (Un-friend) tells the story of two generations connected by blood but divided by circumstance. A devoted father, burdened by responsibility, believes discipline is the greatest form of love, while his son longs for understanding, acceptance, and the freedom to chase his dreams. As life presents new challenges, their inability to communicate creates a growing emotional divide that neither realizes is becoming impossible to bridge. Set against the realities of middle-class life, the film captures the quiet sacrifices parents make, the dreams children carry, and the invisible walls built by ego and misunderstanding. At its heart, KATTI (Un-friend) is a deeply human story about love that remains unspoken, forgiveness that arrives too late, and the enduring bond between a father and son.

title: The Calf Doll
description: In a smog-choked village in Haryana, a retired professor turns to an outlawed ritual, crafting a calf doll from a stillborn's body, to save his cow from the urbanization slowly erasing his rural world.

title: Mann-Pishach
description: In June 1990, a junior archaeologist travels to the isolated village of Hadamgaon to investigate a mysterious stone dome revealed after a monsoon landslide. As he stays with a young widow and observes the village’s strange customs, sealed homes, deserted streets, and a strict rule to lock indoors before nightfall, he uncovers a buried structure built not to worship but to contain the darkest impulses of the human mind. In Hadamgaon, what is buried does not remain silent for long.

title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
description: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.

title: The Legend of Udham Singh
description: In 1919, a young Udham Singh witnessed the horrific Jallianwala Bagh massacre in Amritsar. Seeing hundreds of innocent civilians gunned down under the orders of Acting Brigadier-General Dyer and sanctioned by the Lieutenant Governor of Punjab, Michael O'Dwyer left a permanent scar on his soul. Amidst the blood and cries, Udham Singh took a solemn oath at the site: he would not rest until the man responsible for this tyranny was held accountable.

title: Paharganj to Phuket
description: A simple man from Delhi sets out on what he calls the journey of a lifetime. From the crowded lanes of Paharganj to the shining shores of Phuket. What follows is a story filled with unexpected encounters, new experiences, small revelations, and moments that feel larger than life. As he narrates his adventure, the trip begins to take on a rhythm of its own. Funny, dramatic, and at times strangely intimate. Is it just a holiday? A transformation? Or something else entirely? Paharganj to Phuket is a travel tale about dreams, desire, and the stories we tell when we return home.

title: Last Photograph
description: Avi, a loud and unpredictable extrovert who’s constantly at odds with the world around him, encounters Raunak, a quiet boy who is trying to find his place. Raunak is drawn to Avi’s fearlessness and begins to copy him, believing it will help him make a place for himself.

title: Eberhard as Seen by Amit
description: The portrait of Eberhard Fischer, a Swiss ethnographer and art historian whose life has been devoted to documenting artistic practices across cultures, from mask carvers in Africa to painters in India. His work led to enduring collaborations, including one with filmmaker Amit Dutta. Drawing on archival footage and memory, the film reflects on a long creative friendship.

title: FLOWERS
description: In a small village where people are mysteriously disappearing and found dead afterwards, a young man Nishant who plucks flowers only to see them wilt and a gravedigger who buries unclaimed dead bodies meet and their relationship slowly blooms.

title: Madhur Virli: MasterPeace
description: Madhur Virli talks about relationship, mental health and everything in between.

title: Jaspreet Singh: Grown Up
description: In his debut special, Grown Up, Jaspreet Singh dives into the chaos of becoming a father, the bittersweet realization of his own upbringing, and the sudden loss that changed everything. Blending absurd delivery room stories with nostalgic memories of his brothers, he pieces together a journey of growth, grief, and humor. Dedicated to his father, this special is a full-circle story of what it truly means to grow up.

title: 100 Stairs to Childhood
description: Went back to the place that once felt infinite.

title: deepa didi: The Housekeeper
description: Over time, the routines of Abhi, a young urbanite living in Mumbai, and Deepa, his housekeeper, intertwine.

title: Humid
description: Over a monsoon-soaked day in a crumbling Mumbai building, a young masseuse moves quietly from body to body. Her caring touch soothes the pain of an ailing, bedridden woman, and the anxiety of a new mother, exhausted by duty and desire. As care slips toward intimacy, her hands become a conduit through which life, death, and desire pass without resolution.

title: Candy and the Pizza Ggirl
description: Candy and the Pizza Ggirl is A Hindi Movie.  The story unfolds over one surreal, chaotic full-moon Saturday night in Mumbai, where a single small mistake or catastrophic incident triggers a chain reaction of interconnected, absurd, and unpredictable events. Multiple eccentric characters' lives collide in a fragmented, neon-lit world of illusion, bad decisions, excess, and blurring realities. No one is truly in control; everyone lives in their own version of reality, and chaos spirals as parallel paths overlap.

title: Toaster
description: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

title: Bhooth Bangla
description: A man inherits a palace in rural Mangalpur and plans his sister's wedding there, but strange supernatural events and panicked locals force him to investigate the property's mysterious past.

title: House
description: Aisha and Kabir share both an intimate and bitter past. However, affection does not always convey a happy ending or union. The film explores the same, as it lays bare the many intricacies of a relationship between two people where love could not be enough.

title: The Stolen Future
description: A woman races through the night. Her nerves frayed by the pain of a breakup and excessive drinking, she can barely make out what’s happening behind the rain-streaked windshield. Bang! What was that? Was there a child? Bewildered and assuming she has injured someone, the confused woman gets out of the car, only to find herself in a world of horror. Mirages and apparitions of female ghosts cloud her vision. Her search for a mechanic ends in sheer horror.

title: A Chronicle of the Lost
description: Based on the testimonies of former migrant workers, A Chronicle of the Lost retraces the journey of one of them, embodied by a fictional character wandering through the now-abandoned jute mills of Calcutta. The imaginary letters he sends to his wife, who remained in their village, weave a poignant elegy to a community destroyed by the rise of capitalism.

title: The Curious Case Of Robert Ledru
description: A fictional crime thriller based on the shocking true case of Robert Ledru.  Watch it on YouTube:-  Channel: Unique Script Pictures

title: In the Chaos of Diwali
description: In Delhi, during Diwali, members of a middle-class family find themselves embroiled in a crime. Searching for a solution forces them to confront both the immediate situation and the truths they have been hiding from one another.

title: Licence
description: A fruit vendor, denied a gun licence due to his low status, stages a fake attack with his friends to get around the system. But as the investigation deepens, it reveals a darker, deeply personal motive tied to his past.

title: Ginny Wedss Sunny 2
description: A mismatched pair, with a storyline involving a wrestler and a vibrant girl, combining romance, comedy, and drama.

title: Settlements along the seashore
description: Durgesh, a young actor from Bihar, chases stardom in the chaos of Mumbai, leaving behind a girl he  deeply loves. Just as he begins to lose himself in the city's grind, he learns she has been raped and  murdered. Crushed by grief, Durgesh drifts into silence. The film ends openly like life itself where he  stops resisting and surrenders to the storm.

title: Mast Mahila Mandali
description: Ten women from a working class neighbourhood in Mumbai pick up smartphones to document their own lives, crafting an intimate portrayal of labour, love, friendship and the radical act of claiming joy.

title: The Scene
description: In Ahmedabad, a city where alcohol exists more as rumor than reality, two hostel students step out on a lazy afternoon to eat biryani, wander through the city, and maybe score a drink before the day ends.  But somewhere between a punctured cycle, a pickup truck ride, and a maze-like apartment society filled with cameras and watchful eyes, the outing slowly drifts into something uneasy.  Blending satire with paranoia, The Scene (कार्यक्रम) explores surveillance, suspicion and identity.

title: The Last Tenant
description: A broken musician seeks refuge in an abandoned house before leaving the country. There, memory, music and longing begin to blur. And nothing goes the way he expected.

title: Incredulity
description: A young Indian woman grapples with the aftermath of a toxic relationship with a narcissist. Through a blend of psychological drama and allegorical imagery, the film delves into the subconscious nuances of reeling from the trauma of abuse. As she struggles to let go of her past, the film illustrates the importance of acceptance and finding peace within yourself.

title: Ek Din
description: Dino is in love with his colleague Meera but lacks the courage to express his feelings. He finally gets his chance during the company trip. He makes a wish to be with Meera for just one day, and his wish comes true.

title: Skinny
description: A man and his tumultuous relationship with appearing skinny.

title: Operation Sindoor: A Nation's Resolve
description: To commemorate the anniversary of Operation Sindoor, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh released a documentary film on Operation Sindoor . Iit talks about the nefarious designs of Pakistan over a period of time, against the innocent people of India, and India's national resolve to strike back with precision and accuracy without collateral damage. The whole nation approaches jointness, self-reliance, and indigenisation, ensuring victory. It projects a shining example of political will and integration of forces

title: Krishnavataram Part 1: The Heart (Hridayam)
description: An epic devotional narrative that reimagines the journey of Lord Krishna, tracing his path from Dwarka to Kurukshetra after parting ways with Radha. As his journey unfolds, it explores his connection with people, his layered personality, and the lessons he imparts about love and life.

title: She Sells Seashells
description: A young trinket seller in Goa observes the lives of others and begins to imagine herself within them, until the world beyond the beach calls her back to the life that was chosen for her.

title: Indian Institute of Zombies
description: At an elite engineering campus, students must survive a sudden zombie outbreak while navigating academic pressures and social hierarchies, blending horror with comedy and biting satire of privilege and competition.

title: Daadi Ki Shaadi
description: A grandmother’s mishap with a social media post causes consternation amongst her children and threatens the prospect of her granddaughter’s wedding.

title: Dug Dug
description: Mysterious events in the wake of a freak motorcycle accident sow the seeds of a new religion.

title: Kartavya
description: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

title: Aakhri Sawal
description: Vicky, a brilliant but volatile scholar who ignites a national firestorm when he publicly accuses his legendary mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias. What begins as a faculty dispute is quickly hijacked by a sensationalist news anchor and an ambitious political activist, turning a private disagreement into a televised "intellectual trial" watched by millions.

title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
description: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

title: Sahan
description: Imran Sheikh is a man of dual identities, maintaining a polished, gentlemanly image in public while harboring a volatile nature behind closed doors. His wife, Nusrat, finds herself trapped in a cycle of constant adaptation, struggling to satisfy his increasingly unpredictable and suffocating demands. Despite the growing emotional toll, she remains dedicated to saving their crumbling marriage through sheer endurance. However, her efforts to maintain peace eventually reach a breaking point as the domestic friction escalates. What began as a desperate attempt at harmony soon spirals into a dark and dangerous reality, as things take a sudden, ugly turn.

title: SAMA
description: A Boy's Journey to understand music through Nature and discover his own self in the process.

title: Teesri Begum
description: Pooja Dixit is tricked to marry Babban Khan, only to discover he has two other wives. Renamed "Nagma" in a toxic household, she's crushed when her father dies of grief. She joins with co-wives Tabassum and Shabana to take back her life.

title: System
description: When Neha Rajvansh, a privileged public prosecutor, meets Sarika Rawat, a courtroom stenographer from a humble background, their lives are thrown into upheaval where power defines truth, blurring the system and raising a question of what justice truly means to them.

title: Chand Mera Dil
description: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

title: Direct Recruitment
description: Facing a severe labor shortage after banning Palestinians from entering its borders, Israel approves a skill test conducted by the government of India in Haryana and Uttar Pradesh. The goal is to recruit Indian workers to fill crucial gaps in the workforce in war-prone Israel.

title: Tu Kaun Mein Khamkha
description: Two happily married brothers discover their identical twins live in the same city. As confusion spreads through family and friends, their wives notice strange behavior and seek answers.

title: The Great Grand Superhero: Aliens Ka Aagman
description: Follows a grandfather and grandson whose relationship transforms through the child's imagination when they encounter aliens.

title: Jeena Dil Se
description: A youthful gang's carefree existence spirals into delightful pandemonium after secrets emerge and misunderstandings multiply. Between musical moments and romantic entanglements, they find the courage to live authentically.

title: Krishna Aur Chitthi
description: What happens when the "God of Cricket" and the Lord of the Universe reside under the same roof? Krishna Aur Chitthi is a soul-stirring family drama that explores the thin line between fandom and faith, proving that when an intention is pure, every prayer, whether addressed to Vaikuntha or Wankhede, reaches the same destination

title: Return of the Jungle
description: Nine year old Mihir and his friends are faced with the daunting task of outwitting the biggest, meanest bully in school, Rahul Malhotra. To help them ride through this impossible journey, they turn to Thatha and his fantastic tales of inspiration from the ancient Jungles of India. Together, they must build a ruthless dinosaur, fight a nerve- racking game of cricket and travel all the way to Rajasthan, to rediscover the power of friendship, compassion and determination.

title: How To Not Have Sex
description: Three high school friends reunite after 10 years and confront a case of sexual misconduct that none of them were ready for. As layers of denial resurface, the film traces the thin lines that lie between sex, persuasion, and consent.

title: Chirag Panjwani: Dr. Panjwani
description: A stand up comedy special about Chirag's father and his father's bravery.

title: A Long Marathon
description: This "One-Person-Crew" film tells a story of a female filmmaker who created a daring film about a gay couple, her courage is met not with conversation, but with violence. She gets threatened, humiliated, and abandoned by the very society she hoped to engage via her film. As she goes door to door seeking help, she is met only with humiliation. Pushed to the edge, she joins hands with a contract killer, who is secretly battling his own sexual problem. Together, they begin a dark campaign of vengeance, targeting those who wronged her. As they hunt down the culprits, things seem to settle down but one misstep by the killer throws her into a moral dilemma. Forced to confront the blurred line between justice and destruction, victimhood, and vengeance, she must decide how far she’s willing to go, and what she's willing to become.

title: Momacu
description: On a freezing winter night in rural Haryana, three men steal an ATM and hide it in a tube well room. Overnight, mistrust and chaos shatter their desperate plan.

title: Maa Behen
description: In this dark comedy, a woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — there's a dead body in her kitchen.

title: Maa Behen
description: Three women bound by blood and societal scorn fight to bury a compromising secret, only to find their own suppressed resentments erupting into a volatile domestic standoff that challenges every assumption of their lives.

title: Bandar
description: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

title: Fresher's Party | Stand Up Special
description: Aaditya Kulshreshth (Kullu) hilariously recounts his middle-class upbringing, the absurdities of his first Everest Base Camp trek, and the chaotic dynamics of college friendships. He explores the struggle of trying to be 'cool,' dealing with failed romantic gestures, and the comedic reality of navigating group trips, all with his signature observational wit.

title: Aditya Kulshreshtha: Fresher's Party
description: Aaditya Kulshreshth (Kullu) hilariously recounts his middle-class upbringing, the absurdities of his first Everest Base Camp trek, and the chaotic dynamics of college friendships. He explores the struggle of trying to be 'cool,' dealing with failed romantic gestures, and the comedic reality of navigating group trips, all with his signature observational wit.

title: Billi
description: Kalpu was in her early teens when her cousin touched her, believing she was asleep, though she was not. Upon reaching adulthood, Kalpu decides to confront her.

title: It's Only 47°C
description: In a city pushed to breaking point by extreme heat, traffic constable Laxman Chaubey's exhausting shift reveals a brutal truth: climate change is not endured equally.

title: Vo Ladki
description: Pathik, decides to move on from every memory of Devyani and goes to meet her one last time with a thought of returning the wrist watch.

title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
description: Haunted by a childhood romance and recollections of love lost during the 1947 Partition of India, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal shares his story with his grandson Nirvair, the past unfolding through memories of migration, longing, and a romance that endures across generations.

title: Mahun Dilwala Tahun Dilwali
description: Ragini, a landlord's daughter, runs away from home and meets Raja, a poor farmer, on the bus. She hates him. He keeps saving her. She falls in love. Then finds out her father paid him to follow her.  Betrayed and heartbroken what will Ragini do?

title: Heer Sara
description: Two women embark on a rebellious motorcycle odyssey to Pondicherry - one seeking her lost mother, the other racing to uncover the truth behind a wedding. Laughter, chaos and sisterhood spark freedom, self-worth and eco-conscious living.

title: Chalien Kahin
description: Two parallel life. living in same city, going through Same problems and have Same desire - To go back HOME.

title: Hum Angrezon Ke Zamane Ke Jailor Hai
description: A murder investigation reveals that one family's dark secrets run deeper than anyone imagined. Two determined officers must piece together the truth before more lives are destroyed by lies and vengeance.

title: Disciples
description: On the banks of the Ganges in Varanasi, two boys enter a revered Hindu school where lessons in ancient scripture blur into something more troubling.

title: Haunted 3D: Echoes of the Past
description: A man seeks refuge in a remote Indian mountain mansion, fleeing his past. He discovers the house harbors sinister secrets, pain, and terror ready to torment him.

title: Governor
description: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
description: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

title: Naina
description: 3 Majnus And 33 Lailas !!!!!!  Just Imagine The Chaos................

title: Small Clouds
description: Two siblings escape into a world of adventure aboard a broken ship—until growing up starts to pull them apart.

title: Samarpit Father’s Love
description: Samarpit Father's Love is an emotional story of Ashok, a simple farmer whose life changes forever after losing his wife during the birth of their son, Harsh.After tragedy strikes again when his crops are destroyed in a fire, Ashok sacrifices everything to raise and educate his son.Through hunger, struggle, and endless hardships, he dedicates his entire life to giving Harsh a better future. But when old age arrives and Ashok needs his son the most, life takes an unexpected emotional turn.A heart-touching tale of every father who silently sacrifices his dreams and happiness for his children.

title: Cocktail 2
description: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

title: Threshold
description: The mind builds the Dehleej, but the heart crosses it.

title: Bhram
description: The short film "Bhram" is a psychological thriller that revolves around a doctor named Dr. Shukla.

title: Welcome To The Jungle
description: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

title: Navya Chakra - Psycon World
description: A series of brutal murders across different states throws the country into fear and confusion. The crimes appear completely unrelated, with no clear connection between the victims or the killers, making the investigation more disturbing with every passing day. As pressure builds on the authorities, the mystery continues to deepen and spread panic everywhere, attracting nationwide media attention and creating fear among ordinary people across the country.

title: Tera Mera Nata
description: A heartfelt tale of love, family and emotional bonds, Tera Mera Nata explores relationships tested by time and circumstances. Screened at the 79th Cannes Film Festival, the film earned international acclaim for its emotional storytelling.

title: सिगरेट//سگریٹ//CIGARETTE
description: A tourist joins two coworkers on their daily workday on the road.

title: Songs The Woods Sing
description: Raghu and Megha wander through a hushed forest, silence heavy between them, until unspoken truths fracture their bond. Songs the Woods Sing unfolds as a haunting meditation on love, loss, and the invisible violences that echo in the spaces between what was and what can never be.

title: Light vs Darkness
description: A boy struggles to begin his story in a dark room, unable to find the right starting point. After realizing that life itself begins and ends in darkness, he finds inspiration and decides to start his story with the villain instead of the hero. When the light finally returns, it doesn’t just brighten his house—it brings clarity to his life as well, and as his mother texts asking if the electricity is back, he smiles and replies, “Yes… the light is back,” symbolizing that true stories begin where darkness ends.

title: Kashmir 1947
description: Kashmir 1947 vividly recounts the tumultuous events of 1947–48, drawing on firsthand testimonies, military perspectives, seldom-seen archives, and a captivating narrative. The documentary weaves together music, songs, and potent narration, presenting history in a way that resonates with modern viewers, even those of a younger generation.  "Kashmir 1947" is a documentary that educates, resonates, and stirs the soul. The film transforms history, crafting a compelling narrative that resonates with contemporary audiences.

title: Tavvai
description: In 1880, A Maharaj through his atrocities invited Tavvai. The village is terrified for generations until a chosen one sets things right.

title: Nazar
description: NAZAR is a psychological horror set within a confined space, where a man wakes up restrained and is confronted by a woman who refuses silence. As their interaction unfolds, shifting power dynamics expose entitlement, perception, and suppressed tension, creating an unsettling exploration of control, gaze, and the emotional weight of confrontation.

title: Dial 1975
description: In 1975, India was declared in a state of emergency. This movie tells a story of that year and how the first mobile phone arrived to India.

title: Alpha
description: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

title: Qaid
description: The wait ends.The night begins.

title: Baby Do Die Do
description: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

title: Satluj
description: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

title: KALKI
description: Imagine loving someone your whole life and when they’re gone, you’re not allowed to say goodbye.  This tender short follows a young girl as she navigates the loss of her grandfather. In trying to make sense of his absence, she must also confront a world that decides how, and if, she gets to grieve.

title: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy - The Movie
description: After the Sino-Indian war, a highly trained Indian spy enters Pakistan on a mission to gather crucial intelligence and stop Pakistan from launching an attack against India. Will he succeed?

title: The Ink-Stained Hand and the Missing Thumb
description: If the world had an edge, it might look something like the remote corner of northern India where Santosh and Rajji live, collecting highway tolls in dilapidated booths. Work and endless waiting are blurred together. Bound by the power of love, but also by the need to constantly move around in search of work, they dream of the happiness that awaits them in a new place… until one day, a sudden tragedy turns their lives upside down.

title: Shit Story
description: Sid Silver spirals from existential dread to the best way to battle mosquitoes, questions a breakup cliché that makes no sense, revisits the Telegram ban through a corporate analogy, and reflects on the demise of a man on his way to work, only to inevitably end up in a story involving literal shit.

title: Ikka
description: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

title: Dhamaal 4
description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

title: Ire
description: After a violent outburst, a young man is forced to confront the destructive force growing within him.

title: Munawar Faruqui: Dhandho
description: In this special, Munawar Faruqui shares his side of the story about being jailed.

title: Simulacra
description: Nayan desperately attempts to help Nivi, who has been completely wiped blank, remember the profound past they once shared together.

title: Rahun Main Tere Rubaru
description: A vlogger’s dream getaway turns into a deadly fight for survival when he is framed for murder and races against time to save his kidnapped girlfriend.

title: HIRAETH
description: Dev and Ananya can’t love each other anymore, so they decide to erase the memory of their relationship. But before that, they must relive its worst moments.

title: Indrajaal
description: A legendary treasure hidden during colonial times reappears every 12 years during a solar eclipse. Treasure hunters race to find it but become caught in an ancient prophecy, leading to a gripping tale of ambition and survival.

title: Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi
description: Navya, the only daughter of powerful businessman Devi Prasad, is set for a grand wedding that soon goes off track due to unexpected twists. As secrets unfold and egos clash, the celebration turns into a modern-day swayamvar.

title: Uttar Da Puttar
description: Vastu, destiny and daily life, where unexpected events challenge beliefs about luck, direction and the power to shape your own future.

title: The India Story
description: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

title: Tera Yaar Hoon Main
description: Sanju moves from Nagpur to Mumbai for work and stays with his late mother's friend Viswanath. He falls for Viswanath's daughter Anu, but her marriage is arranged with another man, leaving Viswanath caught between friendship and fatherhood.

title: Max, Min and Meowzaki
description: Max and Min are about to break up. They argue endlessly about dividing their possessions, including their cat, Meowzaki, whom they have named after their favorite artist Miyazaki Hayao. Max’s father Ramesh, who lost his wife and has since been suffering from insomnia, meets charming therapist Dhaara. Max’s grandfather Sridhar, secretly enjoys drinking with his new friend Jennifer at the nursing home.

title: Apology
description: Three friends find themselves in an unprecedented search for an unknown man around their hometown.

title: Sudesha
description: The story of a woman living in a village in the lower Himalayas. In this area, people depend entirely on the forest for their daily needs of firewood, food and water. But the forests have been destroyed by powerful timber traders. And along with the forest, the livelihood of the people has been greatly altered. The women of this region played an active role in the "Chipkow Movement". Sudesha was imprisoned for her protest.

title: The Bose Files: Sach Ya Sazish
description: Veerali joins Anuj, a researcher obsessed with uncovering the truth behind Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's mysterious disappearance, exposing evidence that challenges the official story of his death.

title: Bhai Tera Star Hai
description: An actor's cricket gambling debt puts him on a deadly deadline. His lie about his sister sets off a catastrophic evening of confused criminals, botched crimes, and pandemonium racing across London.

title: LOCKDOWN
description: amidst the ongoing covid lockdown restrictions, a migrant labourer from Bihar struggles his way through orthodox police procedures in Punjab while encountering twists and turns along his way.

title: The Abeyance
description: A grieving young woman struggling to move on after a painful loss finds herself drawn into an unexpected connection that forces both her and the man beside her to confront what it truly means to hold on, let go, and heal.

title: The Chair
description: On Halloween evening, a live in couple settle into their new 1BHK with one ordinary chair, and slowly nothing about the night stays ordinary.

title: Ohh My Dog
description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

title: Aligned Apart
description: Two Strangers. Two Stories. A painful breakup and loss of his job leave Neel searching for purpose, while Tara finds herself struggling to cope with her parents' separation and the uncertainty surrounding her family. As the two unknowingly mirror each other's journeys through loss and healing, their lives repeatedly cross in unexpected ways. Can two lives moving in parallel ever become one?

title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
description: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

title: Hanuman Ansh
description: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

title: Neighbours of the Beast
description: Following the triumphant return of the tigers, the natives develop a deep connection with their forest, Panna.

title: Batwara 1947
description: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

title: Awarapan 2
description: Once a feared gangster, Shivam lives hidden away from his past, with no faith left in God or himself. But when fate pulls him into Bangkok's cartel war and forces him back into the darkness he swore never to return to, Shivam must choose what he is willing to live for, when there is nothing left to lose.

title: Sarvagunn Sampann
description: Play by the book in the day and re-define it by night, what makes a perfect woman?

title: SANJAY VERMA
description: Sanjay Verma was six months old when the Bhopal Gas Tragedy took seven members of his family. He was left with his 13 year old brother Sunil and 10 year old sister Mamta. The story follows Sanjay’s life in the years after the tragedy, his involvement in the fight for justice, and his relationship with an event that shaped his life before he was old enough to remember it. Through his memories and experiences, the film reveals Sanjay’s character, his resilience, and the compassion and hope he carried despite the loss that marked his life.

title: For What It's Worth
description: 'For What It's Worth' is an attempt to understand a movement.  Two filmmakers went to Jantar Mantar after the violence on the 20th of July. They talked to the people there and tried to understand what the protest was really about.  This is them making sense of it.

title: Character's Creation
description: When a writer's manuscript gets repeatedly rejected, he decides to give up the idea of publishing it. But, all of this changes when the main character of the story himself shows up in front of him and questions him about the story.

title: Petals in the Wind
description: A newlywed arranged marriage couple arrive at Goa for their honeymoon. They roam around the city as tourists, slowly getting to know each other in the process. Their honeymoon fantasy comes crashing as an unprecedented revelation sets off a domino of emotional outbursts.

title: Abijit Ganguly: Baby
description: Stand-up special

title: Prashasti Singh: Divine Feminine
description: Prashasti Singh reflects on growing up in a patriarchal Indian family, approaching 40 as an unmarried woman, and the expectations that have shaped her ideas of success, relationships and femininity. Through personal stories about family, therapy, dating and the women who influenced her, she questions whether the life she once aspired to is actually the life she wants.

title: Before You Go
description: It's his birthday, and he's spending it alone,  again. But tonight, an unexpected piece of news changes everything, forcing him to face a promise he's ignored for years.

title: A TOY GUN
description: A classist woman is stuck in a life or death situation and she brings along an innocent stationery shop worker.

title: Harrd Disk
description: Entrusted with a hard disk believed to hold information that could topple ministers, a young boy gets caught in a deadly game between a cop and a political fixer. Everybody wants it. No one knows what's inside.

title: Beyond Ratings
description: Three women share their experience of navigating the app-world in the metro city. The sharings reveal gendered battles as platform workers and the tiresome reality of gig-workers' identities against the absent bosses, masked behind their apps. Filmed in the streets of New Delhi, the protagonists share about their door-to-door gigs, the surveillance at their workplaces and the absence of accountability in the urban landscape.

title: Lost & Found in Kumbh
description: When half-brothers Luke (8) and Rags (13) are separated from their parents amid the immense crowds of Mahakumbh, their disappearance sparks a frantic search. The journey leads to exploration of family, identity, and the unexpected paths that lead us home.

title: Mahaprabhu Jagannath
description: In Kaliyug, the evil asur Aham traps devotees in a mercury-made world, but their faith in Jagannath never breaks. Guided by young Balram's devotion, Mahaprabhu Jagannath defeats Aham through divine wisdom and frees all, proving that true bhakti always triumphs over ego.

title: Babita Singh Reporting
description: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

title: A Tangled Mind
description: Kashmakash tells the story of an artist crushed under the weight of his own expectations - struggling with inner conflict and failing to make sense of the world around him. Torn between love, family, and passion, he spirals down a tragic path of no return.

title: Mirzapur: The Movie
description: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

title: Gandhari
description: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

title: Ciggie NO Biggie
description: A Cigarette creates a rift between two long-lost friends at the night of their reunion. But the Cigarette chooses its own fate.

title: The Critique
description: A simple surveillance gig goes sideways when two petty hustlers paid to investigate a hotel guest realize someone else has their sights set on the target. Genre:  Satire | Dark Comedy | Short-Film | Crime | Neo-Noir

title: Jeevan Bheema Yojana
description: Jeevan and Yojna are a couple drowning in debt who hatch an insurance scheme after crossing paths with Bheema, a stranger who bears a striking resemblance to Jeevan - but things spiral out of control when he turns out to be tangled up in a diamond smuggling racket.

title: Cocaine
description: "Cocaine" is a gripping crime thriller that delves deep into the murky intersection of law enforcement and criminality. Set against the vibrant yet perilous backdrop of Mumbai, the story revolves around a powerful drug cartel that wields significant control over the cocaine trade with the connivance of corrupt police officials and politicians. Abhimanyu Singh stars as Jalal, a diligent police inspector who finds himself entangled in the cartel's sinister web. Despite his best efforts to stay above board, Jalal must go to extreme lengths to protect his own brother, who is targeted by the ruthless cartel. As Jalal navigates the perilous dualities of upholding the law while safeguarding his family, he becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of survival.

title: Second Chances
description: A recently divorced 41-year-old woman spends her birthday weekend with her younger sister, who refuses to let her retreat into loneliness and instead pushes her to confront what she actually wants from life.

title: The Transition
description: Roopantar follows 21-year-old Swaroop from Jodhpur, whose passion for cooking is overshadowed by family responsibilities. During an internship in Delhi, he meets Megha, bringing hope into his life. Encouraged by his brother Bharat to pursue his dream of becoming a chef, Swaroop embarks on a journey of courage, love, and self-discovery.

title: Parched
description: When the water runs out during the journey.

title: Poos Ki Ek Raat
description: The whole world has come to an end due to the spread of an unknown virus from China . A year after the outbreak , Er. Ankur Sharma listens to the telecast of Munshi ji's story Poos Ki Raat on the radio and the safety rules of lock-down , remembering his girlfriend and friend Monty in the last moments of his life imprisoned in his house . . Where he is trying to keep himself alive , lost in the memories of his sin knowing the truth of death , and there is someone at the door who is knocking again and again. Ankur wonders who has come. You can also tell by watching the film who would have come?

title: Herland
description: In a deeply conservative Indian village where women are forbidden from stepping outside without male permission, Bhagyashree and her growing sisterhood rise in defiance, claiming their right to work and confronting generations of patriarchal control. As their resistance gathers force, the cost of being seen as equal begins to turn dangerous. How much are they willing to risk?

title: Lamhaat
description: Lamhaat weaves together six standalone stories set against India's modern city life, each capturing a fleeting moment of longing, guilt, shock, alienation, delusion and regret. Together, they examine how a single instant can reshape a life and leave feelings that linger long after.

title: Lovers in the Blue Night
description: Set against the margins of Mumbai, the film follows four migrants – a gay husband, his wife working in a bar, a thief, and a pimp – whose lives converge around love, survival, and longing

title: Last Man in Tower
description: Masterji is a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.

title: Haiwaan
description: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

title: Maheep Singh: FIR
description: Maheep Singh's dry sarcastic take on social norms and gender politics.

title: Phoolan
description: Follows an impoverished 17-year-old girl who becomes a famous outlaw and survives a brutal 48-hour siege when thousands of armed men trap her in a village.

title: Khoonta
description: A woman bound spiritually to a Himalayan river waits for her missing husband, as her village quietly slips into an uncertain future-where faith, memory, and nature begin to reveal truths no one is ready to face.

title: Bharat Desh Hai Mera
description: The truth of the ordinary citizens of PoK, which has been suppressed for years. The pain of the Kashmiri Pandits, the reality of the helpless people of PoK, and the sufferings, will be brought to the screen for the first time.

title: Nawmai: The Wancho Warrior
description: Bitter enemies Rankho and Longmei clash when Prince Wangthak falls for Princess Sencha, unaware that her tyrannical uncle Liwang seized her throne. When Liwang captures Sencha and demands lost lands, a devastating war ignites between the villages.

title: Zakir Khan: Papa Yaar
description: Zakir Khan reflects on his childhood and the special bond he shares with his father, turning personal memories and family experiences into heartfelt comedy. With his signature blend of observational humour, poetry and emotional storytelling, he explores the unspoken sides of fatherhood and the relationship between a father and son.

title: Vibe
description: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

title: Hari Ka Om
description: Hari Prasad and his son Om are separated because of ideological differences. When Hari suffers a heart attack one morning and announces that he is going to die in six days, his wish to take his last breath at Kashi (Varanasi) with his elder son Om sets them on a destined journey to heal their dysfunctional relationship.

title: Lust Stories 3
description: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

title: Daayra
description: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

title: Ek Kavita
description: The Writer reaches the doorstep of Mogu to gift her the book which he wrote for her especially on her birthday and finds something he was not expecting. This is the story of a night which unravels unrequited love and human relationships. A story which starts after the book "Tum ek kavita thi" ends.

title: Oye Chill Maar
description: Four close friends face challenges when secrets and troubling events reveal the risks of social media obsession. At the center is Prem, a young man dealing with past difficulties and questions of identity.

title: Love Lottery
description: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

title: Don't Be Shy!
description: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

title: Mahakavya: Shri Ramayan Katha
description: A futuristic drama based on the story of the great epic Ramayana with the emotional filming and presentation of the events of Shri Ram's life which has never been seen on screen till now.

title: SONG OF MY MOTHER'S SOUL
description: IDina, a sound recordist, and her mother, a classical singer, share a bond shaped by unspoken emotions and widening distance. As her mother’s health fades, Dina turns to sound to preserve her presence and memory.

title: India: As I Didn't Know Her
description: A young filmmaker backpacks solo across core India, guided by chance encounters that reveal the country beyond politics, nostalgia and a foreign gaze in a sharp and brisk fever dream-like manner, in a one man crew non-fiction feature.

title: The Last Meal
description: Set in 1931 British India, The Last Meal follows Bhagat Singh as he makes an unexpected final request: that his last meal be prepared by Bhoga, a sweeper at Lahore Jail. As Bhoga confronts the deep-rooted stigma of untouchability, the request becomes a poignant act of dignity, equality, and resistance against the social divisions of his time.

title: BOMBAY STORIES
description: Adapted from the short stories of Pakistani writer Saadat Hasan Manto, the film interweaves the lives of three sex workers and their pimps.

title: No, Thank You
description: A slightly disabled kid enters college, and is treated differently due to his condition. But how much of the kindness stems from a genuine place of empathy, and how much of that inadvertently contributes to his own helplessness...?  Created in under 4 hours for a competition.

title: Prem Keetanu
description: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
description: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

title: Pooja Meri Jaan
description: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

title: Tsugi
description: A mystery thriller that starts with a disappearance but ends with mind bending twists.

title: Madhur Virli: Casual - Tea
description: 3rd comedy special of Madhur Virli.

title: The Godawan
description: Resurrection of the great Indian Bustard shown by stop motion film created with blue pottery.

title: Almari
description: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.

title: GOR
description: WHAT IF YOU GET TO ESCAPE  2 individuals from different state are stuck in a reality they can't escape while they encounter their own something vicious

title: Adam and Eve
description: A psychological dark mystery thriller that takes a gripping look into deception and danger. The story follows a seemingly charming and perfect gentleman whose attractive exterior masks the terrifying reality of a cold-blooded serial killer.

title: Only Me
description: A disoriented man wakes up in a car in the middle of nowhere, with a gun, a cryptic note and a bound woman. As events unfold, he is drawn into the disturbing world of a Mumbai model whose carefully constructed rituals blur the lines between victim and predator. Through violence, deception and haunting memories, the film explores trauma, control and the struggle to reclaim one's agency.

title: Memories of her
description: A melancholic short film about love, loneliness, and the memories of someone who was never truly forgotten.

title: Kalpana Aur Yatharth
description: The story of the film originated from real and fictional events revolves around the unreal world, through which a man embarks on an endless journey for his wife who left him.

title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
description: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

title: Jeet Ki Zid
description: Major Deep Singh loses his ability to walk after he gets injured during the Kargil war. Will he also lose his mind and his spirit? Or will he rise again?

title: Poniiy
description: A young local girl's family cares for a dog named Poniiy, whose true owner, a kind-hearted man, has mysteriously gone missing. Determined to reunite them, the girl and Poniiy set out on a heartfelt journey to find him.

title: Nayyi Navelli
description: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
description: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

title: Chennai Vlog
description: Finally uploading this vlog , omg istg i was so lazy to edit these clips and make a vlog , but yeah.

title: Tum Mere Ho
description: Tum Mere Ho is a heartfelt romance starring Gurmeet Choudhary and Isha Malviya, exploring love, emotions, and the unexpected turns that bring two hearts together.

title: Dhood (Sandstorm)
description: Set against the vast expanse of the Thar desert, an isolated family's desperate wishes and psychological friction trigger a dark domestic countdown, threatening to reduce their household entirely into dust

title: Doosra
description: The 2002 NatWest Final was more than a cricketing victory for India. It was a moment when a nation found its voice, and a young girl found the courage to speak her truth.

title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran
description: What starts as a real connection for her turns into his all-consuming obsession. As love darkens, the boundary between devotion and danger fades.

title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
description: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

title: Little Thomas
description: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

title: Udta Teer
description: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

title: Adi Nyemeh – Daughters of the Forest
description: Across Arunachal Pradesh, women carry generations of ancestral forest knowledge. Gathering plants, herbs and other produce, they sustain their families while preserving a deep relationship with the forest amid growing social, economic and environmental pressures.

title: Delicate Darling
description: While she searches for answers, everyone around her seems to have already decided there are none. As certainty slips further out of reach, she finds herself increasingly alone with something no one is willing to name. Delicate Darling is a coming-of-age story about the first time a young girl learns that silence can make you question yourself before you begin to question the world.

title: Udgam: The Origin of Life
description: Set in Chamba, the film follows community worker Rena and local farmers preserving indigenous seeds and traditional farming knowledge amid changing agriculture, water scarcity and uncertain rainfall. Their efforts reveal how seed conservation can protect biodiversity and support climate-resilient livelihoods.

title: The Sinking Monastery of Light
description: Residents of a Himalayan town sinking under its own weight reflect on the meaning and memory of home.

title: Heartbeat
description: In Mumbai’s Bhavani Nagar slum, domestic worker Vimal and her daughter Sonali reflect on education and ambition. Vimal never attended school and hoped Sonali would secure an office job, but Sonali was diagnosed as a “slow learner.” The film portrays their bond with work, learning, and each other.

title: Distance
description: Ambika drives her late best friend’s 13-year-old son, Dhruv, back to boarding school after his father’s sudden death. The ride is strained by Dhruv’s unexplained animosity, which worsens when Ambika’s careless driving breaks his prized windmill science project. The journey culminates when Dhruv confronts her with a painful shared secret.

title: Damned
description: A social-media influencer goes in search of an old, forgotten folk singer Naseem Bano, whose claim to fame was an off-hand compliment from Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan in 1988. He wants her to sing for his Instagram feed but she has forgotten herself. Late at night, when the whole hospital sleeps, she has a flash of memory.

title: Shores
description: Amina’s life revolves around caring for her aging parents and tending to their family home. A surprise visit from her cousin, Azam, brings back memories from 15 years ago. As they catch up on the years lost, they reminisce about her lost love. The unexpected visit gives Amina the closure she never knew she needed, leaving her at peace with her past and more accepting of her present. Years of conflict are resolved through a homecoming and a simple “knock on the door.”

title: Accounts of a Killing
description: The film is a collection of testimonies about how people remember the death of a young man in the town of Khuldabad in the Deccan. Through these memories of a death, each different from the other, the film attempts to sketch a portrait of the town, its people and the contested times we live in.

title: Stray Girls
description: A story from a working-class neighborhood in New Delhi, about a girl’s rebellion and it taking an unexpected magical turn.

title: Hudke Ki Pyaang Pyaang
description: In a small Himalayan town, Vikas and Jyoti, a Dalit boy and a Brahmin girl plan an escape to the city through government teaching jobs. When paying the required bribe demands selling his ailing father’s ancestral shop, Vikas hesitates, causing their relationship to crack.

title: The Ordinary Star
description: Actor Nawazuddin Siddiqui is asked to study Ashok, the actual resident of the room the actor is going to inhabit for the filming of Star, Dibakar Banerjee’s short in Bombay Talkies, 2013. The fiction director, the documentary filmmakers and the actor, bit by bit, construct the lead character of Bombay Talkies, Porandar Vithal. Ashok feeds this construction through his own life. The Ordinary Star is a documentary that ponders over the nature and cost of the cinematic process, it’s invasiveness, it’s need to devour so that it can create, and the endless search to live a life less ordinary.

title: Tenfa
description: In the remote Himalayan village of Kandar, a midwife faces a life-threatening childbirth with no medical recourse. Her only hope lies in finding a wild herb known to heal such cases. The lone person who can identify this herb is an elderly grandmother, living with her teenage granddaughter. So as the three women journey in search - across lands scarred by hydropower projects, they uncover the erosion of both ecology and memory. When an old Kinnauri folksong becomes their guide, tradition and technology converge to revive a fading language, a disappearing landscape, and deep kinship between their people and the earth.

title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
description: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

title: Pyre
description: In the Himalayan Mountain range, a rural village loses its inhabitants to the city’s allure while an elderly couple, Padam Singh and Tulsi, live in desolate isolation. Their days are filled with routine and occasional humour as they mask their loneliness. Their son’s absence gnaws at them, and when a letter arrives promising his return, it reignites their hearts with joy and anticipation. However, the reunion does not unfold as expected, shattering their hopes. As the film climaxes, the spectator is confronted with a more rueful plight, deeply engaging the audience’s empathy.

title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
description: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

title: The Torch
description: Meira foregrounds the historic and continuing resistance of the Meira Paibi, “women with torches” of Manipur. Emerging in response to the pervasive climate of fear produced by the enforcement of the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958, the film traces how ordinary women transformed themselves into vigilant custodians of their communities. Meira situates the movement within a longer genealogy of women-led resistance in Manipur.

title: The Girl Beneath The Sun
description: Teenage sugarcane harvester Shivkanya confronts the realities of early motherhood and marriage, unspoken duties, an eccentric  husband and an uncertain future that shapes and  constrains her dreams, identity and hopes for her child and herself.

title: Kidney
description: In a remote village, two rival families – one privileged Hindu, the other a struggling Muslim family – are trapped in an endless cycle of feuds. A young man dreaming of TikTok fame and a woman yearning to escape patriarchy fall in love. When an inheritance dispute erupts, their relationship is caught between greed, betrayal, and a conflict that threatens to turn blood against blood.

title: V. Shantaram
description: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.

But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

title: The Alfred Eulogy
description: Following the death of his friend Alfred, Ryan prepares to deliver a eulogy. What begins as an attempt to remember the dead gradually becomes a deeply personal confrontation with grief, guilt, resentment, loneliness, and everything left unsaid between two people.  As Ryan’s memories begin to fracture and contradict one another, the distinction between remembrance and reality slowly dissolves. The Alfred Eulogy is an intimate exploration of grief, masculinity, emotional repression, and the weight of words that were never spoken.
